name: Aurora
css: .popover { background-image: linear-gradient(140deg, oklch(70% 0.14 300 / 0.18), transparent 45%, oklch(72% 0.12 220 / 0.14)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.7); backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.7); } .popover, .popover.sheet { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.16), 0 0 0 1px oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.12), var(--docent-shadow); } .popover .arrow { border-color: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.12) !important; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(26px); backdrop-filter: blur(26px); } .button { border-radius: 999px; } .button.primary, .button.primary:hover { padding-inline: 16px; background: linear-gradient(120deg, oklch(80% 0.12 300), oklch(85% 0.1 220)); } .button.primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.07); } .meter { width: 40px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(80% 0.12 300), oklch(85% 0.1 220)) 0 0 / calc(var(--docent-step) / var(--docent-steps) * 100%) 100% no-repeat, oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.14); }
